paragraphs: Rafram at Sikhra. Ha-Mafkid 42a: Rashi explains it as a place-name. That matter in Pesahim 31, end of b, has Rafram bar Pappa of Sikhra. Thus they are one, although Yuhasin gave Rafram bar Pappa a separate entry.
